name: TeamsID
description_en:
TeamsID is a discontinued team password-management service whose customers were moved to TeamPassword. TeamPassword’s transition announcement says the old service ended around February 9, 2024; the former TeamsID website now redirects to TeamPassword.

This is a historical migration profile, not a second current subscription offering. The useful task is to identify missing records and account ownership in an old migration, then evaluate TeamPassword under its own current plans.
description_zh:
TeamsID 是已停止的团队密码管理服务，客户迁移至 TeamPassword。TeamPassword 的迁移公告说明旧服务约在 2024 年 2 月 9 日结束，原 TeamsID 官网现跳转至 TeamPassword。

这是历史迁移档案，不是第二个当前订阅产品。实用任务是排查旧迁移中的缺失记录及账户归属，再按独立当前套餐评估 TeamPassword。

sections.title_en: A retired service, not a new signup choice
sections.title_zh: 已退役服务，不是新注册选项
sections.en:
The successor’s February 2024 announcement explicitly describes TeamsID becoming part of TeamPassword and migration of its customers. This is stronger identity evidence than a redirect alone. It does not establish that every old subscription, feature or permission maps unchanged to the successor.

The old discovery name is retained for lookup, while current TeamPassword capabilities belong in its separate catalog record. This profile does not merge records, approve an alternative relationship or claim that an old TeamsID account can still log in. Shared-directory deduplication needs coordination outside this record’s edit scope.
sections.zh:
后继服务 2024 年 2 月公告明确说明 TeamsID 成为 TeamPassword 的一部分并迁移客户，比单纯跳转更能证明身份关系；但不能证明全部旧订阅、功能或权限原样映射至后继。

保留旧发现名称用于查找，当前 TeamPassword 能力应见其单独档案。本文不合并档案、不批准替代关系，也不声称旧 TeamsID 账户仍可登录。共享目录去重需由本档案编辑范围之外的协调处理。

sections.title_en: Historical migration had a personal-record gap
sections.title_zh: 历史迁移存在个人记录缺口
sections.en:
The migration guide required one organization administrator to initiate. Team-shared records and the initiating administrator’s personal records were in scope; other records shared directly with users needed to be added to teams. Other members’ private records required manual copy/paste or CSV transfer. Therefore, a team-level migration confirmation did not prove every employee’s personal records arrived.

For an old migration audit, compare available source inventories with destination groups, users and record counts, then inspect representative fields and private-record ownership. The guide warns that closing the transfer tab stopped the migration and errors required the stage and message for support. These describe the historical tool; its availability today was not tested.
sections.zh:
迁移指南要求一名组织管理员发起，覆盖团队共享记录及发起管理员的个人记录；直接向用户共享的其他记录需先加入团队，其他成员私人记录需手工复制或 CSV 迁移。因此团队迁移确认不能证明每个员工的个人记录都已到达。

排查旧迁移时，可比较可用源清单与目标组、用户及记录数，再检查代表性字段及私人记录归属。指南警告关闭传输标签会中止迁移，报错需向支持提供阶段和消息。这些描述历史工具，本文未测试其今天是否仍可用。

sections.title_en: Resolve legacy credit with the successor
sections.title_zh: 向后继服务核对旧订阅抵扣
sections.en:
The guide instructed customers to contact TeamPassword before subscribing so remaining TeamsID time could become credit, coupons could be applied and invoice details could be set. This is historical migration billing guidance, not a promise of an available credit or a current TeamsID price. No current standalone TeamsID tariff is asserted.

The help page displays a 2025 author date while retaining a future-tense 2024 shutdown instruction. That stale wording must not be treated as evidence that the retired service remains open. Contact successor support for an unresolved legacy account; do not depend on an unavailable old tool or delete any remaining export before verifying the destination. No migration or purchase was executed.
sections.zh:
指南要求订阅前联系 TeamPassword，以便将剩余 TeamsID 时间转为抵扣、应用优惠及设置发票资料。这是历史迁移计费指导，不保证今天仍有抵扣资格，也不是当前 TeamsID 价格。本文不声明独立 TeamsID 当前费率。

帮助页显示 2025 年作者日期，却保留将来时的 2024 年停服说明，不能据此认定退役服务仍开放。未解决旧账户需联系后继支持，不能依赖不可用旧工具，验证目标前也不应删除剩余导出。本文未执行迁移或购买。
